newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates shares rise slightly in week.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates shares rise slightly in week.

text.p: Stocks on the informal United Arab Emirates market rose slightly in the week to Thursday, with trade focused on new companies, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week over seven points higher at 2,367.45 points.
Ten shares rose and the rest were unchanged.
Dubai Investment Co and Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding Co shares were stable at 15 dirhams and 33 dirhams respectively.
Telecommunications company Etisalat was steady at 940.
Abu Dhabi National Hotels Co shares rose five dirhams to 1,015 dirhams.
